mapper.sql: rb.bridge_id AS bridgeId, rb.refund_id AS refundId, r.refund_no AS refundNo, rb.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.refund_status AS localRefundStatus, o.order_status AS localOrderStatus, rb.order_bridge_id AS orderBridgeId, ob.provider_sku_id AS providerSkuId, rb.provider_id AS providerId, p.provider_code AS providerCode, rb.provider_order_id AS providerOrderId, rb.provider_refund_id AS providerRefundId, rb.provider_refund_no AS providerRefundNo, rb.bridge_status AS bridgeStatus, rb.provider_refund_status AS providerRefundStatus, rb.refund_amount AS refundAmount, rb.fee_amount AS feeAmount, rb.currency_code AS currencyCode, rb.request_idempotency_key AS requestIdempotencyKey, rb.retry_count AS retryCount, rb.max_retry_count AS maxRetryCount, rb.manual_hold AS manualHold, rb.next_attempt_time AS nextAttemptTime, rb.provider_request_time AS providerRequestTime, rb.provider_refund_time AS providerRefundTime, rb.last_operation AS lastOperation, rb.last_sync_status AS lastSyncStatus, rb.last_error_code AS lastErrorCode, rb.last_error_message AS lastErrorMessage, rb.last_error_retryable AS lastErrorRetryable, rb.create_time AS createTime, rb.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_source_refund_bridge (refund_id,order_id,order_bridge_id,provider_id,provider_order_id,bridge_status, provider_refund_status,refund_amount,fee_amount,currency_code,request_idempotency_key, retry_count,max_retry_count,manual_hold,last_sync_status,create_time,update_time) SELECT #{refundId},#{orderId},ob.bridge_id,ob.provider_id,ob.provider_order_id,'PENDING_REVIEW', 'NOT_REQUESTED',r.refund_amount,r.fee_amount,COALESCE(ob.currency_code,'CNY'), CONCAT('REFUND:',#{refundNo}),0,#{maxRetryCount},0,'PENDING',NOW(),NOW() FROM refund_record r JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=r.order_id AND o.fulfillment_mode='TICKET_SOURCE' JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge ob ON ob.order_id=o.order_id WHERE r.refund_id=#{refundId} AND r.order_id=#{orderId} AND ob.provider_order_id IS NOT NULL AND ob.provider_order_id<>'' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE refund_id=VALUES(refund_id)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o WHERE o.order_id=#{orderId} AND o.fulfillment_mode='TICKET_SOURCE'

SELECT FROM ticket_source_refund_bridge rb JOIN refund_record r ON r.refund_id=rb.refund_id JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=rb.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=rb.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge ob ON ob.bridge_id=rb.order_bridge_id WHERE rb.refund_id=#{refundId} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ticket_source_refund_bridge rb JOIN refund_record r ON r.refund_id=rb.refund_id JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=rb.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=rb.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge ob ON ob.bridge_id=rb.order_bridge_id WHERE rb.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY rb.bridge_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM ticket_source_refund_bridge rb JOIN refund_record r ON r.refund_id=rb.refund_id JOIN ticket_order o ON o.order_id=rb.order_id JOIN ticket_source_provider p ON p.provider_id=rb.provider_id JOIN ticket_source_order_bridge ob ON ob.bridge_id=rb.order_bridge_id WHERE rb.manual_hold=0 AND COALESCE(ob.order_model,'') <> 'SINGLE_SKU' AND rb.bridge_status IN ('PROCESSING','RETRY_WAIT') AND (rb.next_attempt_time IS NULL OR rb.next_attempt_time<=#{now}) ORDER BY COALESCE(rb.next_attempt_time,rb.update_time) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_source_refund_bridge SET bridge_status='REQUESTING', last_operation='REQUEST_REFUND', last_sync_status='PENDING', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0, manual_hold=0,version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE refund_id=#{refundId} AND bridge_status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW','RETRY_WAIT','MANUAL_REVIEW')

UPDATE ticket_source_refund_bridge SET provider_refund_id=COALESCE(#{providerRefundId},provider_refund_id), provider_refund_no=COALESCE(#{providerRefundNo},provider_refund_no), bridge_status=#{bridgeStatus},provider_refund_status=#{providerRefundStatus}, next_attempt_time=#{nextAttemptTime}, provider_request_time=COALESCE(provider_request_time,#{providerRequestTime}), provider_refund_time=COALESCE(#{providerRefundTime},provider_refund_time), last_operation=#{operation}, last_sync_status='SUCCESS',last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0, manual_hold=0,response_snapshot=#{responseSnapshot},version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE refund_id=#{refundId}

UPDATE ticket_source_refund_bridge SET bridge_status=#{bridgeStatus},last_operation=#{operation},last_sync_status='FAILED', last_error_code=#{errorCode},last_error_message=#{errorMessage},last_error_retryable=#{retryable}, retry_count=retry_count+1,next_attempt_time=#{nextAttemptTime},manual_hold=#{manualHold}, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE refund_id=#{refundId}

UPDATE ticket_source_refund_bridge SET bridge_status='REJECTED',provider_refund_status='NOT_REQUESTED',manual_hold=0, next_attempt_time=NULL,last_operation='REJECT_REFUND',last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE refund_id=#{refundId} AND bridge_status='PENDING_REVIEW'

UPDATE electronic_ticket SET ticket_status='EXPIRED',qr_code_value=NULL,credential_payload=NULL, expire_time=COALESCE(expire_time,#{refundTime}),abnormal_reason='第三方退款成功，电子凭证已失效', refund_hold_status=NULL,refund_hold_abnormal_reason=NULL,update_time=#{refundTime} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND (ticket_status IN ('UNUSED','GENERATING','ERROR') OR (ticket_status='EXPIRED' AND refund_hold_status IS NOT NULL))

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='REFUNDING',provider_order_status='REFUNDING', last_operation='REQUEST_REFUND',last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0, version=version+1,update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('PAID','REFUNDING')

UPDATE ticket_source_issue_task SET task_status='STOPPED',manual_hold=1,next_attempt_time=NULL, last_operation='STOPPED_BY_REFUND', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message='订单已进入退款终态，停止第三方履约', update_time=NOW() WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND task_status IN ('PENDING','WAIT_PROVIDER','PROCESSING','RETRY_WAIT','FAILED','PARTIAL')

UPDATE ticket_source_order_bridge SET bridge_status='REFUNDED',provider_order_status='REFUNDED', last_operation='REQUEST_REFUND',last_sync_status='SUCCESS', last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL,last_error_retryable=0, version=version+1,update_time=COALESCE(#{providerRefundTime},NOW()) WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND bridge_status IN ('PAID','REFUNDING','REFUNDED')
